title: The Hills Full of Fire
themeTags: God is with us even when we can't see
God is bigger than what scares us
reflectionQuestion: Elisha and his helper were surrounded by something scary — but God was with them the whole time, even when they couldn't see it. When you feel afraid, what helps you remember that God is near?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Elisha's Invisible Army, 2 Kings 6:8-23). Mood=anxious (thin). FEELING-FIRST: scared, surrounded, outnumbered. Image: the hills full of horses and chariots of FIRE all around Elisha ('more on our side than theirs'). Adam edit: do NOT call them 'God's army' (Scripture doesn't) -- 'they had been there... around Elisha.' War handled by subtraction (no violence); the beautiful mercy ending kept (Elisha feeds the enemy + sends them home). Final line = God's PRESENCE not 'God's help'. Voice TBC (proposed VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH_PROFESSIONAL).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He answered, “Don’t be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.”
